claim: The sample applies text size, line spacing, contrast, letter-shape, and reduced-motion settings to a clean article.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo/; change every setting; assert rendered article state; reset and assert sample defaults

claim: A reading card exported as a JSON text file imports into a second clean demo session.
sandbox: two fresh Chromium contexts at /demo/; change and export in the first; import the file in the second; assert every value and rendered article style

claim: The demo uses a separate temporary demo namespace and sends no data to third parties.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo/; change a setting; assert only demo: session storage, empty local storage, and same-origin requests

claim: The demo reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo/; wait for service-worker control; set context offline; reload and assert sample article and demo banner

claim: The landing page reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /; wait for service-worker control; reload online once; set context offline; reload and assert the landing heading and offline notice

claim: The static site has no analytics, advertising, tracking pixels, cookies, account system, or remote fonts.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context across /, /demo/, /privacy/, /terms/, and /404.html; record requests and response headers; assert same-origin requests, no Set-Cookie, and an empty cookie jar

claim: The extension stores its reading card and current article in local extension storage without remote requests.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile; save a card; inspect chrome.storage.local; render a stored article; assert no HTTP requests

claim: Turn the reader off for one site and return to its original article.
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile with a stored article; turn the reader off; assert the original URL opens and the local per-site override is disabled

claim: Article extraction keeps headings, lists, quotations, tables, and safe links while removing active page code.
sandbox: jsdom article fixture with semantic content, a relative link, script, navigation, and advertisement

claim: Reader Setting Transfer is free and open source.
sandbox: repository checkout; assert MIT license text and no payment SDK dependency

claim: The landing page and demo support keyboard use and a 390 px viewport without page overflow.
sandbox: fresh Chromium page at 390 × 844; visit landing and demo; operate each by keyboard; assert the sample heading is in the first demo viewport, no overflow, and no serious axe findings

claim: The isolated demo opens with the sample article heading and first paragraph visible at 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900.
where: Try it with sample data action and demo
sandbox: fresh Chromium contexts at 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900; open /?demo=1; assert the sample heading and start of its first paragraph are inside each initial viewport

claim: Removing the extension removes its browser-managed local data.
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile; store a private sentinel; uninstall the extension through its self-management API; reinstall it in the same profile; assert extension local storage is empty

claim: The extension refuses clearly marked paywalls and does not restyle source pages.
sandbox: jsdom pages with visible and hidden paywall markers plus public app content; assert visible gated extraction is refused and every source DOM remains byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: The product site provides the packaged extension ZIP.
sandbox: fresh built site; fetch the download; assert its response type, ZIP signature, and required MV3 package entries

claim: The extension reads article text only after the reader opens it and selects Read this article.
sandbox: fresh MV3 profile; visit public pages before opening the extension; assert extension storage stays empty and no automatic content script exists

claim: The extension does not read or store pages while the reader browses without opening it.
sandbox: fresh MV3 profile; visit two pages without opening the extension; assert extension storage remains empty and no extension requests or injected elements appear

claim: The packaged Chromium extension previews type, spacing, and contrast changes, then applies text size, line length, paragraph and line spacing, letter spacing and shapes, contrast, and reduced motion in the reader.
where: landing first screen and how-it-works, README
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile; change preview type, spacing, and contrast; save every reading-card field; open a stored article; assert every rendered style and reduced-motion state

claim: On a supported public article, Read this article opens the reader with extracted article text, safe links, the active site, and the saved reading card.
where: landing how-it-works and reader description, README
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile; open a real local public article, invoke the packaged extension popup, choose Read this article, then assert saved extraction and the new reader tab

claim: A reading card exported from the packaged extension imports into a second clean extension profile.
sandbox: two fresh MV3 Chromium profiles; export a complete card from options in the first, import it in the second, then assert storage and reader styles

claim: The extension makes no remote requests.
sandbox: fresh MV3 Chromium profile; inspect manifest and installed dependencies; use options and reader; assert no HTTP requests, cookies, remote permissions, or unexpected storage keys
